verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Spend AI pages document that AI captures receipts, extracts and checks key fields (date, amount, merchant, tax), and matches receipts to the right card transactions, including partial receipts and split transactions. Missing for 10: the specific capture channels in the story (snapping a photo in a mobile app, forwarding an email) are not documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of OCR accuracy or matching.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction

citations.quote: AI captures receipts and matches them to the right card transactions without manual input from employees.
AI checks receipts for required details like date, amount, merchant, and tax information.
AI handles partial receipts, split transactions, and timing mismatches so expenses don’t get stuck.
